features: Live Life and Play with three stylish colors
Speedy print: It only takes about 12 seconds to send and print your images, plus, around 100 photos can be printed on a single charge
Print from your smartphone via Bluetooth
Compact size: Small size fits just about anywhere and perfect for on-the-go
Select and print: Use the display screen to get your best shot and select the images to print
description: The instax mini LiPlay is the perfect blend of great fun and unique functions. As a hybrid instant camera and smartphone printer, you can click, print, reprint, store, transfer, and play with photos to your heart’s content. There's also an app to support more functions like filters and frames, direct print, and remote shooting. And, with the Record Sound feature, it's the only camera that captures the sounds of the moment. The world of instant photography just got limitless!
